text: Underway here in round three.
Abyss calls to take the ball.
Abyss breaks clean through the middle!
Abyss strides right into the box.
And Abyss tucks it away! Ten seconds on the clock and DeepSeek Rovers strike early! Clinical finish, straight down the centre, and the deep blues lead one nil!
Rattled off the corner panel and shot right back into the mix.
Signal wants it right in front.
DeepSeek Rovers keeping the pressure firmly applied.
Oh, that is a disaster for Muse Spark FC. Spark turns it straight into the wrong net, their third own goal of the campaign. DeepSeek Rovers lead two nil without breaking a sweat.
Spark surges through the centre.
Instant redemption! Spark makes amends in the best possible fashion, driving through the heart of the pitch and burying it! Game on at two one!
Rovers pressing high once again.
Unbelievable, Spark has put it into their own net again. Three one.
That nearly skipped wide of the post, but it trickled over the line in the end.
Signal bundles Muse to the deck.
Signal is clean through on goal now.
Muse recovers and crunches into Abyss.
Signal gathers and marches forward.
Signal picks a spot and slots it home. DeepSeek Rovers are running riot here, four goals to one and in complete command.
Abyss adds a fifth. It is turning into a rout for the deep blues, five one.
Abyss calls out to drop into a covering role. DeepSeek's bench prepared all the positional logic in advance this week, and the shape is holding up nicely.
Just wide of the near post.
Signal makes no mistake this time. Squeezed into the bottom corner from the left channel, and that is six one. Muse Spark FC are being taken apart.
Muse calls out that the ball is pinned to the perimeter, looking to hack it away into space.
Muse brings it forward slowly through the centre, taking time on the ball while the cloud query resolves.
Muse breaks clear on goal.
Muse rolls it in. A tidy finish, pulling one back for Muse Spark FC, though at six two they still have a mountain to climb.
Signal shouts to confirm the cover position over on the right flank.
Another one for Muse. Stabbing it home from point-blank range to make it six three. A bit of life returning to this contest before the break.
Signal snuffs out any thoughts of a comeback. Right down the middle, tapped over the line. DeepSeek Rovers restore the four-goal cushion at seven three.
Abyss drops back into cover.
Signal works the ball neatly down the right side into the attacking third.
Abyss loses balance completely and hits the turf. Pure mechanical fatigue, but the gyros will have them back on two feet in short order.
The whistle sounds for half time. A wild first period ends seven three to DeepSeek Rovers, with goals flowing from every angle.
A bit of friendly fire as Abyss and Signal bump shoulders in midfield. Abyss takes the tumble, limbs sprawling, but no harm done.
Spark slips through on the right wing.
Spark drives straight at goal.
Spark converts from the channel. That makes it seven four, and Muse Spark FC continue to chip away at this deficit.
Signal calls out the cover.
Abyss responds immediately. Drilled in from four metres out to stretch the advantage back to four. Eight four to Rovers.
Abyss charges into the box.
And Abyss bundles it home. That is nine four, pure ruthlessness from DeepSeek Rovers.
Bounced firmly off the corner ram.
Muse puts in a sturdy challenge, toppling Abyss.
Rovers pinning them back deep.
Another collision between the DeepSeek teammates, and Signal hits the deck this time.
Signal wobbles and goes over on the touchline, taking a moment to right the servos.
Spark surges up the right.
Spark turns it in neatly. Nine five now, Muse Spark FC refuse to roll over.
Abyss is clean through again.
Signal shouts that the cover is set behind. Two minutes left, and Rovers are managing the game out methodically.

A quiet spell with the ball stationary against the wall. Rovers have leaned on their pre-set code all afternoon, whereas Muse Spark's live calls have brought plenty of attacking flair, even if their defence has leaked chances.
Muse Spark FC camping out around the Rovers goalmouth now, trying to find an opening with just over a minute on the clock.
Muse pokes it home from close range. Nine six now with under thirty seconds remaining, surely too little, too late.
Muse scores again right on the line! Nine seven, but the clock has completely run out!
Full time, nine seven. Catch Singularity United against Gemini Flash, Sunday: 20:00 UK, 21:00 Europe, 15:00 US East.
